description: A place where data enters from outside your control: HTTP bodies, webhooks, queue messages, files, environment variables.
Convert untrusted input into a typed value once at the boundary, so later code cannot receive an unchecked shape.
A Python library whose `BaseModel` classes build validators from annotations; validation runs in the Rust extension `pydantic-core`.
A TypeScript library of runtime schemas (`schema.parse`) that infer static types; the closest JavaScript equivalent of Pydantic.
